subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Should this umbrella stay open as one issue, and which operator-visible surface should non-tool skill prompt rewrites use?
rationale: The missing code paths are source-clear, but the status performance boundary and prompt-rewrite diagnostic UX need maintainer product direction before implementation.

options.title: Split focused follow-ups
options.body: Track status registry diagnostics separately from prompt-rewrite diagnostics, choose the warning surface first, and keep each implementation bounded with tests.

options.title: Keep this umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker for both remaining quick wins, accepting that one implementation crosses status, skills, docs, and tests.

options.title: Narrow to status diagnostics
options.body: Treat existing skill check/docs as enough for skill discoverability and keep only the status registry diagnostics request.

recommendation.title: Split focused follow-ups
recommendation.body: Track status registry diagnostics separately from prompt-rewrite diagnostics, choose the warning surface first, and keep each implementation bounded with tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already posted the prior keep-open review and has the clearest cross-surface history for deciding whether to split or sponsor the remaining UX surface.
